column2: start_year - first year of model run
elapsed_year - elapsed year of model run
ncov - the number of coverage types included in the model
ngrid - number of ICM-LAVegMod grid cells - will be an array dimension for all grid-level data
ncomp - number of ICM-Hydro compartmenets - will be an array dimension for all compartment-level data
dem_res - XY resolution of DEM (meters)
grid_file - csv with X and Y coordinates (UTM meters) of grid cell centroids grid cell area (sq meters) and overlaying ICM-Hydro Compartment number
build_neighbors - flag - set to 1 if near and nearest neighbor lists need to be built from Grid XY data - set to 0 if neighbor files already exist
nearest_neighbors_file - text file with list of grid cells that are the defined nearest neighbors
nearest_neighbors_dist - distance in which a neighboring grid cell is considered a nearest neighbor (meters) *must be smaller magnitude than "near_neighbor_dist"*
near_neighbors_file -  text file with list of grid cells that are the defined near neighbors
near_neighbors_dist - distance in which a neighboring grid cell is considered a near neighbor (meters) *must be larger magnitude than "nearest_neighbor_dist"*
max_neighbors - maximum number of grid cells that will be allowed in the near and nearest neighbor lists - this will be the number of columns in the neighbor files
coverage_attribute_file - file name - with relative path - to csv with model attributes for each coverage type - this file row-order must match the column-order of veg_in_file below

prob_table_type - define which approach to use for est/mort probabilities; (1) use the universal probability of mortality/establishment tables for emergent marsh; (2) use the individual species-level establishement and mortality tables
n_niche_ptiles - number of percentile bins defining the species-level salinity and WLV niche ranges (must correspond to the number of columns provided in 'coverage_attribute_file'
n_ptile - number of bins defining the percentiles included in the universal mortality and establishment probability tables (with axes units of percentile)
n_X_bins - number of bins definiing the X-axis of the establishment and mortability input tables (with axes units of ppt and meters)
n_Y_bins - number of bins definiing the Y-axis of the establishment and mortability input tables (with axes units of ppt and meters)
veg_in_file - file name with relative path to *vegty csv file saved by ICM-LAVegMod in previous year run
hydro_comp_out_file - file name - with relative path - to compartment_out.csv from current model year's ICM-Hydro simulation
morph_grid_out_file - file name - with relative path - to grid_data.csv file from previous model year's ICM-Morph simulation
hydro_daily_stage_file - file name - with relative path - to daily timeseries of water surface elevation from current ICM-Hydro simulation
hydro_daily_tiderange_file - file name - with relative path - to daily timeseries of tide range from current ICM-Hydro simulation
runprefix - file naming convention prefix
write_intermediate_files - set to 1 if intermediate output files should be written - set to 0 to only write end-of-year files
